content.expected_result: Ambiguous legacy heads are non-destructive errors; explicit Git resolution yields one current story.
preconditions: Use merged checkout story revisions r2-a and r2-b descended from r1; each branch definition is complete and distinct.

steps.action: Run normalize on distinct r2-a and r2-b legacy heads.
steps.expected_result: Normalization identifies both heads and leaves both files unchanged.

steps.action: Preserve both branches in Git, combine their content explicitly, resolve the legacy head set, then normalize.
steps.expected_result: The resulting current.json contains the selected combined content without a new Saga revision graph.

steps.action: Query Git-backed history for the stable story and inspect the original commits.
steps.expected_result: Both authored branch values and the resolution commit remain inspectable through real Git.

content.title: Preserve competing legacy story content before Git resolution
